questions.question: Appraise the importance of pro-social behaviour and the characteristics of Pro- Social behaviour.
questions.solution_html:
• Appraise the importance of pro-social behaviour and the characteristics of Pro- Social behaviour.
  • Importance of Pro-Social Behavior
  • Pro-social behavior is crucial for building and maintaining healthy, supportive relationships and
  • communities. It benefits both individuals and society by fostering cooperation, trust, and mutual
  • support. Some key reasons why pro-social behavior is important include
  • a) Strengthens Communities and Social Bonds (4 mark)
  • b) Promotes Mental and Emotional Well-Being.
  • c) Encourages Reciprocity and Cooperation
  • d) Reduces Conflict and Increases Peace
  • e) Promotes Social Responsibility
  • Characteristics of Pro-Social Behavior
  • Satisfaction and Commitment-The satisfaction in a relationship is determined by the comparison
  • between the actual rewards and costs versus the expected rewards .
  • Commitment refers to the willingness of individuals to maintain a relationship over time.
  • Example: A couple may feel satisfied in their relationship when they both experience equal efforts
  • and benefits, leading to a long-term commitment to the partnership.
  • .
